BiblicalUsage: Zeeyr is the Aramaic word for small, and it carries the whole weight of Daniel's vision. Out of the ten horns of the fourth beast comes up a little horn, small at first, but with eyes like a man and a mouth speaking great things.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe small beginnings do not mean small endings, and Daniel warns us to watch the little horn most of all.
